summary: Fixed desktop-console toolbar: Back/Forward, creation buttons including New VM, VM power group with a confirmation dialog, host actions in a Host menu.

guide.reason: Operator-visible navigation changed: fixed toolbar groups with greyed reasons, New VM entry point, power confirmation dialog, and host actions moved to a Host menu.

api.reason: Existing contract, no reference change: the toolbar calls the existing site, enrollment, refresh-inventory, revoke and VM power contracts with unchanged requests, request identities and results; no Core command, client schema or API page changed.

state.reason: No durable state. Toolbar enablement is derived from the hosts' reported inventory each render; the New VM handoff is transient UI state.

verification.method: npm typecheck and build; tests/integration/phase1.py --browser against a disposable HTTPS Controller with the real agent, including a new fixed-toolbar group and a labeled simulated-VM power dialog group; captures inspected.
